backup.go:*Backup.update.note: re-copies a page that was already backed up if it changed under us

backup.go:putUint32BE.note: big-endian u32 writer used for schema-cookie bump

btree.go:*Cursor.CountUntil.note: any-store range-count fast path batching by page

btree.go:*Cursor.Skip.note: any-store batched forward skip; no SQLite counterpart

btree.go:*Cursor.SkipBackward.note: any-store batched backward skip; no SQLite counterpart

btree.go:*btree.collectLeafCells.note: any-store helper used by rebuild/balance paths

db.go:*DB.BeginReadFast.note: fast path skips page-1 counter read

db.go:*DB.GetNamespace.note: any-store namespace lookup in master btree

debug_trace.go:trace.note: Go-only no-op stub under !debugtrace build tag; debug tracing facility with no SQLite counterpart

debug_trace_on.go:init.note: Go package-init that configures a stderr/file log.Logger gated by BTREE_TRACE env var; no SQLite analogue (SQLite uses sqlite3_config(SQLITE_CONFIG_LOG) callbacks, not package-level loggers).

debug_trace_on.go:trace.note: Thin wrapper over log.Logger.Printf for build-tagged tracing; any-store-specific debug scaffolding with no SQLite origin.

osfuncs_sync_other.go:fdatasync.note: non-Linux/non-vfs fallback wrapping os.File.Sync (portability shim, no direct SQLite origin)
